extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: retro two-door coupe, approx. 4.5 x 1.75 x 1.35 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.62 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels with whitewall tyres are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, two seats and steering wheel; no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
